report.summary: Prometheus is crash-looping (restartCount 8). About 7 seconds after each start it panics inside its text-format parser while scraping the metrics-target service. Metrics collection is repeatedly interrupted.
report.root_cause: The scrape target metrics-target (an nginx container) serves a malformed 5-byte body on /metrics instead of valid Prometheus exposition text. When Prometheus 3.10.0 scrapes it, PromParser.Labels panics with a slice bounds error (promparse.go:237) and the whole process exits. Each restart scrapes the same bad payload and crashes again. The panic comes from the scrape of metrics-target, not from resource exhaustion: oomKilled is false and memory use is about 28 MiB. Two defects are at play: the target exposes invalid metrics output, and Prometheus 3.10.0 does not handle malformed input gracefully. I could not read the prometheus.yml or the target's actual response body, so the exact malformed content is inferred from the 5-byte size.
